candidate_relations.reason: A single IgA beta-2 glycoprotein antibody with infarcts raises antiphospholipid syndrome as a related differential, not MIS-C itself.
Platelets remain 281×10^9/L, so disseminated intravascular coagulation is a different unsupported entity from MIS-C.
Streptococcal toxic shock is a related septic-shock differential after tonsillitis, but negative ASOT and the multi-organ inflammatory picture point to MIS-C.
A macular rash without epidermal necrosis is not Stevens-Johnson syndrome, a different mucocutaneous entity from MIS-C.
Acute kidney injury with dialysis is an organ manifestation of the multisystem process, not the unifying MIS-C diagnosis.
Dilated cardiomyopathy with EF 30–35% is the myocardial manifestation of MIS-C, not the full inflammatory syndrome.
Septic shock describes the distributive presentation with high procalcitonin but is not the requested MIS-C object.
There is no widespread epidermal necrosis to support toxic epidermal necrolysis, a different disease from MIS-C.

case_quality_flags: Eighteen-year-old with negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR; MIS-C is the reference despite missing documented prior COVID-19
